note:
base_import_module: the ir.attachment lookups in _import_static_attachments and _import_translation_attachments are hoisted out of their per-file loops into one _get_attachments_by_url query each.

NOT A GATE ARTEFACT -- THE OPPOSITE. Decomposing _import_module first moved both searches into a shared _upsert_attachment helper, which has no loop of its own, so this count fell by 2 while every query still ran: the AST checker cannot see across a call boundary. Banking that would have hidden a live N+1. The searches are now genuinely batched, one per module instead of one per static file and per translation.

Proof is the query count, not the finding count: base_import_module test suite 1633 -> 1622 queries, 36 tests green either way.

  309 -> 307
